priceSnapshot.note: RUN TIMING, stated first because it changes how this file should be read: the midnight job fired late. It is stamped 08:40 COT, not the usual 02:00 COT, so this report covers the WHOLE overnight window plus the Asian and European sessions, and it landed on top of the morning slot rather than ahead of it - see the concurrent-run disclosure in decisionBox.changed. Endday published at 86,266.8; thirteen hours later spot is 85,797.7, down 469.1 points or 0.54 percent on the handover, and up 1.01 percent on the rolling 24-hour open of 84,938.8. The path mattered far more than the net change. Between the two reports the tape ran 86,406.3 down to 85,111.1 and back, a 1,295.2-point box: the overnight leg lost the 85,631.3 January shelf intraday, bottomed 1,155.7 points under the endday mark, and was bought back 884.6 points in roughly five hours. Endday's reduce gate was a settled 1H close below 85,325.2; the lowest settled hourly close of the entire defence was 85,344.9 at 07:00 UTC - the gate missed by 19.7 points and did not fire. Price is now 47.7 points above the 85,750.0 liquidation shelf and has slipped back under its own 15m EMA20 at 85,914.98 and 15m EMA50 at 85,813.93.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below 85,111.1, the overnight session low. That is the price at which 869,859 USD of forced long selling was absorbed and reversed, and it is the low of the higher-low sequence that has held since the 17 September breakout. A wick under it is not enough - three hourly bars (05:00, 06:00 and 07:00 UTC) closed between 85,344.9 and 85,412.6 while the wick was 233.8 points lower, which is exactly the pattern that saved endday's gate. The level trails DOWN 214.1 points from endday's 85,325.2 deliberately: a gate that survives by 19.7 points has told you it is sitting inside the noise, and re-arming it at the same place invites the whipsaw that did not quite happen last night. Below 85,111.1 the next structural level is 84,719.5.

addIf.confirmation: A SECOND spot tranche on a test of 85,344.9 that holds on a settled 1H close. 85,344.9 is the exact low of the overnight hourly defence and sits 452.8 points below the current mark, so a retest that holds gives a materially better basis than this one with a stop only 233.8 points underneath at 85,111.1 - a defined-risk construction rather than a hope. The continuation alternative is a settled 4H close back above 86,617.9, yesterday's UTC open and the level the tape lost overnight; that reclaim re-opens 86,406.3 and then the 87,399.0 eight-month high, and it clears the 86,250.0 short-liquidation pocket on the way.

decisionBox.changed: Position moves from endday's TAKE_PROFIT to ADD, and the trigger is that endday's own pre-committed gate fired. Endday raised 18.45 USDT explicitly to fund a retest buy at 85,600.0; overnight the tape went straight through it to 85,111.1 and then reclaimed, with the 08:00 UTC hourly closing at 86,215.5. Honouring a pre-committed gate is what worked for midday on 21 September and what morning got wrong on the same day, so this run buys rather than re-reads the chart. Three facts support it and two argue against, and the sizing reflects that. FOR: the ETF print was revised UP, hard - Farside now shows plus 999.0 million USD for 21 September, not the 617.6 endday could see at 19:41 COT, making it the largest single-day US spot-Bitcoin-ETF inflow of the month and a third consecutive positive day worth plus 1,591.5 million; 4H RSI cooled from 86.43 to 75.18 WITHOUT price breaking structure, which is a healthy reset rather than a failure; and funding for the 16:00 UTC settlement is plus 0.0001, the practical floor, so nobody is paying carry to be long. AGAINST: open interest ROSE 2.38 percent to 2,625,187,027 USD while price fell 0.54 percent, which is fresh longs added into weakness rather than absorption, and the OKX long/short account ratio has flipped from 0.93 at endday to 1.01 now, so the net-short cushion that endday leaned on is gone. That is why this is an 18 USDT spot tranche and not a leveraged position: the reduce gate trails down to 85,111.1, the add gate inverts into a deeper 85,344.9 retest, invalidation holds at 84,719.5 because it was never tested, and the resting stop is stood down - the overnight gap endday was protecting against has already been survived and the next four hours are liquid US cash hours. CONCURRENT-RUN DISCLOSURE, and it governs the wallet line of this file: while this midnight job was gathering data, the scheduled MORNING job for 2026-09-22 executed independently and finished first. It published 2026-09-22-morning.json at a mark of 85,985.0, reached the same conclusion from the same evidence, and ran the ledger with the identical trade - an 18 USDT spot buy, taking cash from 49.03 to 31.03 and the spot book from 0.00192503 to 0.00213437 BTC. It also backfilled the 21 September endday calibration row with the same reduce_fired=false / add_fired=true verdict reached here independently. This session therefore did NOT run scripts/paper_wallet.py: the wallet is already positioned exactly as this report argues it should be, and a second run would double the tranche and append an out-of-order snapshot behind the morning one. The decisionBox stance below stays ADD because that is the correct read of the tape; the execution of it simply already happened, six minutes and 187.3 points earlier.

liquidation.note: 756,135 USD of LONG liquidations against 275 USD of shorts - 99.96 percent long-side, and the single largest bucket in the window by a factor of six. This is where the overnight flush actually happened, and fills were still printing into it as recently as 13:28 UTC while spot was 86,000. Spot is 47.7 points above it right now, which makes it the nearest magnet and the level this session is buying against. Realized fills map where leverage has already died, not where stops rest now, so a cluster this size cuts both ways: it is proven demand because the flow was absorbed, and it is a proven pain point because the market keeps returning to it.

112,847 USD of long liquidations and zero shorts. The secondary shelf underneath 85,750.0, sitting between the 85,631.3 January reclaim level and the 85,344.9 hourly-defence low. If 85,750.0 gives way this is the pocket that gets swept on the way to the add gate.

50,176 USD of SHORT liquidations against 9 USD of longs - the mirror image of the shelf below and the only meaningful squeeze fuel overhead. It is small: 50,184 USD total against 869,257 USD measured below spot, a ratio of better than seventeen to one. It sits just under the 86,406.3 session high, so a reclaim of that zone runs it.

24,962 USD of short liquidations against 868 USD of longs, 202.3 points above spot. Thin, and only notable because it is the first thing price has to chew through to get back toward the 86,250.0 pocket and the 86,617.9 UTC open.

etfFlows.note: The single biggest change since endday, and it is a REVISION. Endday read Farside at 19:41 COT and recorded plus 617.6 million USD for 21 September. The completed row now prints plus 999.0 million - IBIT 381.4, ARKB 289.1, FBTC 238.8, MSBT 61.7, BITB 21.6, GBTC 3.3, BTC 3.1 - which is 381.4 million more than endday could see and makes it the largest single-day US spot-Bitcoin-ETF inflow of the month by a wide margin. The three-day streak is 17 September plus 159.5, 18 September plus 433.0 and 21 September plus 999.0, worth plus 1,591.5 million, and the rolling five-session net swings to plus 845.2 million from minus 450.4 on the 15th and minus 295.9 on the 16th. The 22 September row is an all-dashes placeholder totalling 0.0 - the US close has not happened, so it carries no information yet. Read against open interest RISING 2.38 percent while price fell, the picture has inverted from endday's: then it was spot buyers absorbing leveraged sellers; now it is leveraged buyers adding into a market that spot demand has not yet had a chance to confirm. liquidations.note: Realized OKX fills over the window 2026-09-22T09:53:49Z to 2026-09-22T13:33:08Z: 869,859 USD of longs against 75,412 USD of shorts, so longs took 92.0 percent of the damage - a near-total inversion of endday's 61.9 percent. The 85,750.0 bucket alone absorbed 756,135 USD of it. Open interest is 2,625,187,027 USD, UP 2.38 percent from endday's 2,564,275,351 while price fell 0.54 percent: positions were ADDED into weakness, the opposite of endday's short-covering signature, and that is the single most cautionary number in this file because fresh leverage added at a worse price is exactly what the 85,750.0 shelf feeds on. The skew figure is the OKX long/short account ratio at 1.01, newest hourly bucket 13:00 UTC, having printed 1.00, 1.01, 1.00, 1.01, 1.00 over the preceding five hours. Endday recorded 0.93 and falling - accounts net SHORT into a rising tape, which kept forced buying as the crowded-side risk. That cushion is gone: the book is now balanced to marginally long, so forced selling and forced buying are roughly symmetric and the seventeen-to-one measured imbalance below spot is no longer offset by crowd positioning. Funding for the 16:00 UTC settlement is plus 0.0001, the practical floor, so at least no long premium is being paid to hold the risk.

calibration.note: Endday's reduce gate at 85,325.2 required a settled 1H close beneath it. The overnight low was 85,111.1 - 214.1 points through the level - but the lowest settled hourly CLOSE was 85,344.9 at 07:00 UTC, so the gate missed by 19.7 points and priorReduceFired is false. The wick-versus-close distinction endday explicitly wrote into the confirmation is the only reason the position survived intact, and that is the third time in four sessions it has mattered. The recommended resting stop at 84,650.0 was never approached; the invalidation at 84,719.5 was never tested. actingHelped is true, narrowly and honestly: endday sold roughly 0.00021389 BTC at 86,266.8 and the mark is now 85,797.7, so the trim is 469.1 points onside, worth about 0.10 USD on a slice that small. The larger point is what did NOT happen - endday kept 90 percent of the core long through a 1,155.7-point drawdown and that was the decision that carried the value. Endday's add gate at 85,600.0 traded and is marked fired, with the caveat that the confirmation it asked for, a settled 1H close holding the level, failed three times before the 08:00 UTC bar reclaimed at 86,215.5; a mechanical fill at the touch would have been 686.5 points better than this session's execution. Procedural note: the 21 September endday row in calibration.json was backfilled by the concurrently-running 2026-09-22 morning session before this file was written, with the same verdict independently reached here (reduce_fired false on the 19.7-point settled-close margin, add_fired true on the reclaim rather than a clean hold, acting_helped true but near-neutral at this size). This session did not rewrite it.
